title: Annual Leave Policy
content: Full-time employees at Acme Corp accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at a rate of 1.67 days per month. Employees must give at least two weeks notice before taking leave exceeding three consecutive days. A maximum of 5 unused leave days may be carried over to the following calendar year. Any unused leave beyond 5 days is forfeited at year end. Leave requests must be approved by the direct manager. Leave cannot be taken during the company's designated blackout periods in Q4.
